prompt:
Write release notes of at most 120 words covering ALL 5 merged changes below. Name each change's pull request number exactly as written (#NNNN). Use only facts stated in the changes; invent no number or identifier.

--- change 1 (repo omnibase_core, pull request #1301) ---
feat(OMN-13152): ArtifactStore Phase 1 hardening — retention/quota/redaction/restricted-tier read (#1301)
* feat(OMN-13152): ArtifactStore Phase 1 hardening — retention/quota/redaction/restricted-tier read

Extends the durable-capture ArtifactStore (OMN-13093 minimal slice) in place
with Phase 1 hardening:

- Retention classes (ephemeral/session/ticket/permanent) with configurable
  per-class default TTL; explicit per-write TTL override.
- Quota enforcement: max per-write size and max total per-scope size. Exceeding
  either raises ArtifactQuotaExceededError with no silent truncation or partial
  wr

--- change 2 (repo omnibase_core, pull request #1146) ---
feat(OMN-11928): add ModelKnowledgeContextBundle and sub-models (#1146)
* feat(OMN-11910): add ModelAntipatternEntry, ModelAntipatternExample, ModelAntipatternRegistry models

Defines three frozen Pydantic models for the antipattern detection registry:
- ModelAntipatternExample (model_antipattern_example.py): good/bad code snippets
- ModelAntipatternEntry (model_antipattern_entry.py): single antipattern rule with
  severity, enforcement, category, pattern_type, vector_enabled, and a model_validator
  enforcing that pattern_type=semantic requires vector_enabled=True

--- change 3 (repo omnimarket, pull request #3331) ---
test(routing): fill boundary and outcome test gaps (OMN-17427) (#3331)
Test-gap fill on routing, with no source change.

- tests/nodes/node_routing_complexity_compute/test_routing_boundaries.py:
  both sides of all six complexity rung thresholds; prompt token and
  source-count band boundaries; empty and oversized prompts;
  dependency-point cap; workflow and rubric-input refusal; invalid
  provenance rejection.
- tests/nodes/node_llm_delegation_routing_compute/test_routing_outcomes.py:
  preferred, next preferred, fallback and tier override outcomes; expiry
  at t

--- change 4 (repo omnimarket, pull request #3686) ---
feat(OMN-20866): merge a green, clean omnimarket PR at its head instead of arming it (#3686)
* feat(OMN-20866): wire landing orchestrator config, head-checks, and PR state ingress

- node_pr_landing_orchestrator builds PrLandingOrchestratorConfig from a new
  landing_config block in its contract.yaml (orchestration/contract_config.py).
  An unknown key, mode or operation in the block is refused at load.
- landing_config declares: default github_mode dry_run; OmniNode-ai/omnimarket
  enforce; dry_run_operations rerun_runs, update_branch, disarm (stay dry_run in
  every repository until t
